title: UC provost unaware of laws secretly benefiting universities
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of UC provost unaware of laws secretly benefiting universities, about recent at University of California research university, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You know, I talked to the provost of a UC university, major research university. He had no idea how the laws had been changed to secretly benefit universities for doing particular kinds of work.

plain: A mathematician named Eric Weinstein says he once spoke with the provost, a top academic officer, of a major University of California research school. According to Weinstein, the provost had no idea that laws had been changed to quietly reward universities for doing certain kinds of work. He tells it to suggest that hidden research arrangements exist that even university leaders do not know about.
